title: Samsung is expected to more than double output of its HBM4 and HBM4E DRAM
summary: Samsung is reportedly planning to more than double its production output of HBM4 and HBM4E high-bandwidth memory DRAM next year, according to industry sources. The move reflects surging demand for advanced memory used in AI accelerators and data center GPUs, intensifying competition with SK Hynix and Micron in the AI hardware supply chain.
